scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d db redis backend celery celery-beat frontend nginx
scripts.docker:up:core: docker compose up -d db redis backend frontend
scripts.run: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c yellow,blue "npm run run:backend" "npm run run:frontend"
scripts.run:backend: cd backend && set DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.dev&& python manage.py migrate && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000
scripts.run:worker: cd backend && celery -A config.celery worker -l info
scripts.run:beat: cd backend && celery -A config.celery beat -l info
scripts.run:all: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,worker,beat -c yellow,blue,green,magenta "npm run run:backend" "npm run run:frontend" "npm run run:worker" "npm run run:beat"
